items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: he was the manager of the Southern Rhythm Boys Band that I played in before I came to California.

ctx.x: Oh, sure. Were there any musical people also brought on to it?

Well, Dave Dexter, of course, that was instrumental in getting me on records. And one other person was brought on, was very comical, was a guy named Alan Prade, who I think I mentioned earlier. He was at one time the head of the -- he was the manager of the Southern Rhythm Boys Band that I played in before I came to California. He was also at one time, he had a band called Alan Prade's Syncopators, or something like that.

But nevertheless, he was brought out for this. He was living down south, in Port Arthur,…
